sloka: स सञ्ज्ञां प्राप्य तेजस्वी चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः।अर्दितश्च प्रहारेण कम्पनः पतितो भुवि ।। ६.७६.३ ।।
transliteration: sa sañjñāṁ prāpya tejasvī cikṣepa śikharaṁ gireḥ।arditaśca prahāreṇa kampanaḥ patito bhuvi ।। 6.76.3 ।।

translations.english: Rejuvenated Angada, after gaining consciousness acquired a mountain peak and shattered Kampana with a blow. wounded Kampana fell down.
